artifacts.summary: Four-phase close-out of the compiled sufficiency verdict: a two-arm non-vacuity fixture (phi4 = (T U b) and (T S a1), R4 = {y0,y1,y2}) giving realizes_of_certAdm_cohBi a compiled instance, measured true at plan time; header and guard decision-row update; ROADMAP.md rewritten to the verdict and the cohBi/label-level rulings 761 inherits; the complete gate set and summary. Six headline signatures pinned in a plan-time-compiled Lean Challenge block.

memory_candidates.content: When a lean plan pins a Lean Challenge Statements block, compile it standalone at plan time with sorry bodies AND append #eval lines after the namespace end for every decidable Scope Hypothesis figure (closure cardinalities, concrete edge facts, a certificate's Bool value on a candidate fixture). Mathlib oleans are cached, so the compile costs seconds, and the plan's figures become measurements rather than hand computations: a fixture whose certificate #evals to true cannot fail on a false statement, only on proof labour. Pair it with the collection's discipline that the committed probe keeps exactly one #eval (the closure cardinality) and proves the rest.
